articles.title: pnpm 12.16.1
articles.summary: This release fixes pnpm install hanging on a cold store in workspaces that install Cargo crates, and pnpm pack shipping a file that files excludes by name. Patch Changes pnpm install no longer hangs on a cold store in a workspace that also installs Cargo crates or a Rust toolchain. pnpm pack and pnpm publish now apply a files entry that names a file after the glob and directory entries, as npm does. A file excluded by name, such as !dist/index.js , stays out even when a later dist/** matches it. A file named by its path, such as lib/secret.js , ships even when a later !lib/*.js matches...

articles.title: openclaw 2026.9.35
articles.summary: This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. articles.title: pnpm 11.28.9
articles.summary: This release fixes a crash on registry responses with too many content encodings ( GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c ) and sizes the install worker pool by the container's CPU quota. A repeat pnpm install now acts on more setting changes. Patch Changes Crashes and security A registry response with too many content encodings can no longer crash pnpm. pnpm now uses undici 7.30.1, which fixes GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c . pnpm install now sizes its worker pool by the CPU quota of the container it runs in, such as a Kubernetes CPU limit, when that quota is smaller than the number of CPUs the container may run on....
